from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790687704/attempts/d0cbcca9117b44429be50328a5ec3220/system/state/workspace/programs/task-c45330e1.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    if not grid:
        return out
    last = len(grid) - 1
    # The 5s on the bottom row are upward-running markers. Each marker
    # carries its current color upward, changing color when it meets a
    # nonzero cell in its column.
    for c, value in enumerate(grid[last]):
        if value == 5:
            color = value
            for r in range(last, -1, -1):
                if grid[r][c] != 0:
                    color = grid[r][c]
                else:
                    out[r][c] = color
    return out
'''
p.write_text(source)
print(p)
